newsitem.title: CHINA: China Communist Party membership reaches 58 million.
newsitem.headline: China Communist Party membership reaches 58 million.

text.p: China's ruling Communist Party now boasts 58 million members with increasing numbers of young people joining the world's largest surviving socialist organisation, the Xinhua news agency said.

Since its 14th congress in 1992, the Chinese Communist Party has built up its grassroots structure, particularly in rural areas where many cells had weakened or were even defunct, it said in an overnight report.

Latest statistics from the Organisation Department showed the party now counted 58 million members, an increase of 9.92 million compared with 1992 -- or one member for every 20 of China's 1.2 billion people, it said.
Some 43.4 percent of party members have an educational background above senior high school level, the figures showed.
The party is also becoming younger, with 22.4 percent of its members under the age of 35, the report said.
However, the Organisation Department sounded a note of caution, warning that not everyone could hope to gain membership.
"While the Party endeavours to expand its membership, it makes special efforts to ensure the quality of its new blood," Xinhua quoted the department as saying.

The party is expected to hold its 15th congress later this year, possibly as early as mid-September, when it will decide the line-up of China's leadership and the direction of policy for the next five years.
